_doc: Cursor-specific metadata for each skill. Consumed by scripts/sync.sh to regenerate rules/<name>.mdc from skills/<name>/SKILL.md. The description here is the Cursor-style brief (one line summary); the SKILL.md description is the Claude Code trigger sentence.

propose-then-implement.description: Default to propose-then-implement. Investigate, present options, wait for approval before changing code.

investigate-before-fixing.description: Investigate root cause before writing any fix; cap hypothesis attempts

loop.description: End-to-end engineering loop — think, plan, build, review, test, ship, reflect

verify-with-runtime.description: Verify changes against real runtime evidence before claiming done; stale evidence is not evidence

self-review-before-handoff.description: Read your own diff like a stranger before declaring done; calibrate confidence with quoted evidence

clean-commits.description: Keep commits and PRs surgical. Exclude unrelated changes; target the right branch.

capture-learnings.description: After shipping or debugging, capture one durable lesson per session

manage-context-window.description: Treat the context window as a finite budget; prefer narrow reads, delegation, and clean handoffs over dragging stale context forward.

delegate-with-fresh-context.description: For self-contained subtasks, delegate to a fresh subagent with a precise brief instead of inheriting your conversation context.

break-work-into-verifiable-steps.description: Decompose non-trivial work into a sequence of small, independently verifiable steps with explicit acceptance checks per step.

tests-first-by-default.description: Default to test-first for new behavior and bug fixes — write the failing test, watch it fail for the right reason, then write the minimal code to pass.

prefer-project-local-rules.description: When project-local rules or skills contradict cadence on the same topic, follow the project-local rule and mention the conflict once.

update-callers-on-contract-changes.description: When you change a shared contract (signature, schema field, union variant, dispatch type), update every caller and test in the same change.

run-lint-and-typecheck.description: After edits, run the project's linter and type checker; fix what you introduced.

no-placeholder-sentinels.description: Don't reuse "", 0, None, or null as sentinel values for distinct lifecycle states — model the state explicitly.

never-edit-generated-code.description: Never hand-edit generated/codegen output; change the source schema and regenerate.

keep-files-focused.description: Keep files small and single-purpose; split by responsibility when they grow.

imports-at-top.description: Keep imports at the top of the file; avoid inline or mid-function imports.

feature-local-by-default.description: New code lives next to the feature that uses it; promote to shared only when broadly reused.

complete-refactors.description: Refactors must land complete in one change — no orphan call sites, legacy aliases, or compat shims.

nullable-equality.description: TypeScript — use `== null` / `!= null` for nullability checks; strict equality everywhere else.

no-any-no-casts.description: TypeScript — don't use `any` or `as` casts to bypass the type system.

named-exports.description: TypeScript — use named exports; avoid `export default`.

explicit-undefined.description: TypeScript — prefer explicit `| undefined` over optional `?:` for data-shaped fields.

theme-tokens-only.description: Frontend — use the design system's theme tokens for colors, spacing, and typography; no raw hex/RGB or magic pixel values.

react-compiler.description: React 19 + Compiler — default to no manual memoization; only reach for it when referential identity genuinely matters.

prefer-generated-api-client.description: Frontend — use the project's generated/typed API client wrapper; never raw fetch/axios.

centralized-query-options.description: Frontend — define server-state queries/mutations via centralized option factories; avoid ad-hoc inline keys.

register-models-in-admin.description: Backend — when adding a new ORM model that has an admin/inspection UI, register it with a minimal usable configuration or document why not.

percent-style-logging.description: Backend — in Python logging, pass format args as separate parameters (%s style); don't pre-format with f-strings.

no-hacking-central-infra.description: Backend — don't modify central infrastructure (settings, base classes, middleware, shared fixtures) to make a single test or eval pass.

dont-apply-migrations.description: Backend — generate migrations during development; do not run/apply them against shared databases on the user's behalf.

async-orm-relations.description: Backend — in async code, eagerly fetch related ORM fields; don't rely on implicit lazy loading.
